notes.title: 🗡️ Ready to Become a GladMort Master?
notes.content:
Hey warriors!

Have you been braving the chaotic arenas of GladMort but still feel like there's more to master?

We’ve got you covered!

📖 Check out the official GladMort guide 
👉 Become a GladMort Master – The Ultimate Guide

Whether you’re just getting started or looking to perfect your combos, this guide dives deep into: 


 Core mechanics and advanced tips
 Character abilities and weapons
 How to survive the madness longer (and with style)
 Hidden tricks only the best gladiators know


Sharpen your skills, dominate the leaderboard, and show the world you're no mere mortal.

Let the bloodsport begin! ⚔️
